schema:
CREATE TABLE accounts (account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tier TEXT);
CREATE TABLE monthly_usage (account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id), period TEXT NOT NULL, usage_amount REAL, PRIMARY KEY (period, account_id));
